decision_1_goal.named_by_user: net expectancy after 1.5x costs, lower bootstrap bound above 0, beats baselines, U2 same direction
decision_1_goal.items_in_tier_1: a, c, d, e, f, g as gate v2 defines them, until the user decides the open question below
decision_1_goal.open_question_for_the_user: the user's wording names items d, e and f. Items a, c and g are not named. Item c is kept here because no instruction removed it, but it is a win-rate test: at 100 dates it needs 53 to 60 wins depending on h and the number of specs, so a positive-expectancy model below that win rate fails

decision_2_timing.rule: a field public by the close of D may use D. Any other field stays at D-1. An unverified publication time counts as D-1

public_by_close_of_d.note: board notices count only when stamped before 15:30 on D; these features already read D in features_v1

index_file: close, for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY and India VIX

stay_at_d_minus_1.reason: no stored evidence of publication by 15:30. The manifest holds same-evening fetches on 2 dates only, at 20:52 and 21:14; both are after the close

decision_2_timing.consequence: features_v1 already follows this rule. Features for D still read D-1 for market data, while the baselines in item e read D's close

decision_3_item_g.option_a: the model only uses families that exist in that fold, fixed in advance per fold
decision_3_item_g.option_b: folds without a family are excluded from the 70% rule, with a minimum fold count stated now

exists_tests.item_g_minimum: at least 100 signal dates with at least 20 U1 stocks filled
exists_tests.stricter: at least 80% of the fold's dates and 50% of U1 stock rows filled

validation: still used once per frozen model spec
